notes: All 37 cards checked against Plates 85, 86, 72, 77, 87 and the clinical table (p. 216-218). Every node group Netter labels already had a card except the superior deep lateral cervical nodes and the three facial subgroups, which are proposed as new cards. The facial-buccal-nodes Divisions detail restates subgroups already in that card's name and Location; drop it if redundancy is unwanted. Not labeled by Netter and left unchanged: neck levels I-VII and sublevels IA/IB, IIA/IIB, VA/VB; prelaryngeal (Delphian), paratracheal, infrahyoid and scalene nodes; lateral/medial retropharyngeal subgroups; pre-auricular, infra-auricular and intraglandular parotid subgroups; lingual nodes; tubal tonsil (Netter shows only torus tubarius); the pharyngeal lymphoid ring as a named whole; right lymphatic duct, subclavian and bronchomediastinal trunks (head and neck plates label only the jugular trunk and thoracic duct). Cards thyroid-nodes and inferior-deep-lateral-cervical-node contain '(Netter Plate 85)' inside their Location text, a citation inside card text; not changed here. New cards carry no 'shape' field and reuse the parent card's marker, so the three facial subgroup markers coincide with facial-buccal-nodes and should be nudged on the diagram.
